name: NEXUS DevOps Intelligence
summary: Read-only CI/PR digests of ONE public GitHub repository, plus default-OFF approval-gated write actions and a daily health card.

write_actions.name: rerun_workflow
write_actions.description: Re-run only the failed jobs of one workflow run

write_actions.name: label_pr
write_actions.description: Add labels to one pull request

write_gates: valid single-use approval token (nxa1, HMAC-SHA256, payload-hash bound)

approval_token.payload_hash: sha256 of jarvis canonical_json({action, params}) == nexus_jarvis.approvals.store.payload_hash

health_sources.NEXUS_DEVOPS_HEALTH_ORACLE_HEARTBEAT: file or URL; JSON {ts} or ISO line or file mtime
health_sources.NEXUS_DEVOPS_HEALTH_NEON_USAGE: file or URL; JSON {storage_gb_used, compute_hours_used, limits optional}
health_sources.missing_source: reported as status unknown, never a guess
